thread:
alex.support: FYI escalating to CS — NovusAI trial can't get invited users to accept invites. Support attempted sends and we're getting consistent 550 bounces for provider outlook.com / hotmail. Customer worried they can't onboard before pilot kickoff next Tue. Ticket #56012.

mailer-bot: Alert: delivery-failure rate increased for mailer-route-3 at 2024-08-22T09:12Z. Error: 550 5.1.1 <recipient@outlook.com> User unknown.

alex.support: Repro steps I left in the ticket: created user, triggered welcome_email, send returns 550 for ~12 addresses across two orgs (novus-staging, novus-prod). Sample log:
```
2024-08-22T09:10:45Z WARN mailer route3 send failed 550 5.1.1 recipient not found to=recipient@outlook.com org=novus-staging message_id=msg-21
```
Customer says some recipients are internal testers and definitely exist.

priya.cs: OK — immediate ask: do we have a safe fallback to get those users in quickly? Also need comms draft: brief apology, what we did, ETA for full fix, and offer to onboard them manually if needed. We should flag as renewal watch until pilot completes.

sam.csm: I can do manual invite links via admin panel as a stopgap if we can provide a temporary deep-link. Prefer engineered fix first so we don't do manual heavy-lift. Customer is open to a 1hr enablement tomorrow at 11am ET.

taylor.engineer: Quick triage: looks like delivery failures are provider-side rejects for some domains. Two mitigations:
1) Spin up domain-split routing for novus (route via partner-smtp that handles outlook better). Needs opt-in from customer for alternate from-address.  ETA ~45m to enable and requeue invites.
2) Generate one-time onboarding tokens and share secure links via support portal or chat. ETA ~10m to produce links for ~15 users.
Which do you want?

priya.cs: We'll do both: tokens now to unblock invites, and routing change as durable fix. Sam, please confirm you'll run the enablement tomorrow and bring a test user to validate. Sam ok to own tokens sending?

sam.csm: Yep I can share tokens from support console. Will CC customer and set expectations. I'll also run through SSO config in the call.

alex.support: Implemented token flow for the first 8 impacted users and posted secure links in ticket #56012. Command used by support: 
```
./create_onboarding_token --org=novus-staging --users=email1@outlook.com,email2@outlook.com --expiry=48h
```
Links generated and DM'd to customer admin. Noted in ticket.

mailer-bot: Monitoring: route3 rejection rate unchanged.

devops-bot: Note: partner-smtp route available but sending domain will change from @redwood-inference.com to @mail-redwood-partner.com. Legal/Trust required. Logged CR-772 for audit.

priya.cs: Legal confirmation: NovusAI has contract clause allowing alternate sender for critical onboarding. Sam — include that in the comms so customer knows why sender changed. Draft comms for review:
"Hi <Admin>, sorry for the trouble — some provider rejects blocked invite emails. We've generated secure one-time links to complete account setup (posted in your support ticket). We're also enabling a backup sending route that will use a partner sending domain so invites reach users reliably. This will not change your account settings and is temporary. Can we confirm a 11am ET enablement call tomorrow?"

sam.csm: Posted that to customer, they replied OK for 11am ET and appreciated the quick links. Also asked for a short postmortem after fix.

priya.cs: Action items recap:
- Sam: run 11am ET enablement, validate SSO and acceptance of invites, log onset of pilot.
- Taylor: enable partner-smtp route for novus-prod and novus-staging, confirm send success and report bounces within 2 hours.
- Alex: keep tokens/watchlist in ticket and close once all users accept invites.
- Priya: draft short internal postmortem and add to onboarding runbook noting partner route fallback and token flow. Flag customer as renewal-watch until pilot completes.

alex.support: Acknowledged, updating ticket #56012 with all actions.

mailer-bot: Update: partner-smtp trial send succeeded for 5 test invites at 2024-08-22T09:37Z.

priya.cs: Thanks team. We'll follow up after the enablement. If any resend fails, escalate to eng-sre immediately. "
